try: Open {url} and type /why: one line per pane (rule, the question, your answer) and a summary of the items, each statement with its source in brackets (file:line). Three days of history are synthetic fixture data.

Type /why map (every question, answer and add, with the question line) and /why dec-2 (proposed by morrow, from your message m-f003, the quote, confirmed by you). Click "show m-f003" to scroll to that message.

Click "why?" on a pane bar or a card (or Tab to it and press Enter): the same explanation. /why dec-8 says plainly what was not recorded ("set by you (file edit), when is not recorded"); /why task-7 shows a hand edit that was ("added by you (file edit) at …").
Make the window narrow (about 820 px): labels stay whole and the kanban stacks its three columns when its body is narrower than 420 px.
